title: camara involucrata
intro: Camara involucrata, commonly known as the False Buttonbush, is a plant species native to tropical and subtropical regions of Central and South America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Camara involucrata include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it useful for relieving coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
